title: The dead economy theory
ai_summary:
• The concept refers to a stagnant labor market where new hires don't fill existing vacancies due to low demand.
• This theory can be seen in sectors like finance, with some companies reducing hiring and others freezing expansion.
• Tech giants and startups alike might be impacted, but its effects may be limited to certain areas and firms.
student_angle: NONE, this article provides insight into broader industry trends, but does not directly impact entry-level job opportunities.

title: SQLite is all you need for durable workflows
ai_summary:
• SQLite is an embedded relational database management system that supports ACID transactions.
• It's open-source, self-contained, and doesn't require a separate server process or setup.
• SQLite supports SQL syntax and common database operations like queries and indexing.
student_angle: Learn SQLite for fundamental database skills and understanding how storage works, essential for any CS job.
